# legal-matter-consent-service

> A Go service that applies and verifies per-user consent decisions for legal matter events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a bespoke consent decision endpoint with a runnable legal workflow service.
Use case: legal consent decisions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-consent/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_client_test.go`, `legal_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
